handoff.summary: Deterministically scanned the frozen 16-field correctness pool with pristine PARI 2.17.4 and froze the first nontrivial successful unequal-bound identity, panel row 21. The same-source scheduler replays six immediate successful probes, transient KCZ values 4, 5, 6, final restoration to 3, exact ideal publication, and zero RNG consumption through CPython, JavaScript, GMP, and tagged backends. The performance panel and shared driver are unchanged.
risks: This successful identity has no failed retry and therefore does not exercise random products, Q_primpart, or high-bit idealred.
It has no nonidentity automorphisms, so pr_orbit_fill remains generic work.
The existing arbitrary-field collector fixture exporter does not prepare this quintic; its six success decisions remain authenticated pristine-PARI observations rather than Sage.js collector outputs.
